none: PAS NLM-9C8096: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, possibly Constans (333-350), if so, a Gloria Exercitus issue of 333-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed head right. Obverse inscription: [---]ANS. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.09gms, die axis: 12
